CREATE TABLE business_schema_control (
 singleton_id TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
 mode VARCHAR(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 required_writer_epoch INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 schema_version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 reader_basis VARCHAR(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 version BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 changed_at_utc DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
 CONSTRAINT p14_control_single CHECK(singleton_id=1),
 CONSTRAINT p14_control_mode CHECK(mode IN ('EXPAND','MAINTENANCE','ENFORCED')),
 CONSTRAINT p14_control_reader CHECK(reader_basis IN ('RECORDED_TIME','BUSINESS_DATE')),
 CONSTRAINT p14_control_versions CHECK(required_writer_epoch>0 AND schema_version>0 AND version>0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE business_posting_policies (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
 organization_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 branch_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 policy_version BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 business_timezone VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 date_algorithm_version VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 live_date_mode VARCHAR(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 archive_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
 combined_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
 effective_from_utc DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
 created_by INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 created_at_utc DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE KEY p14_policy_tenant(organization_id,id),
 UNIQUE KEY p14_policy_branch(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 UNIQUE KEY p14_policy_version(organization_id,branch_id,policy_version),
 CONSTRAINT p14_policy_branch_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id)
  REFERENCES branches(organization_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_policy_actor_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,created_by)
  REFERENCES users(organization_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_policy_mode CHECK(live_date_mode='TODAY_ONLY'),
 CONSTRAINT p14_policy_zone CHECK(business_timezone='Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'),
 CONSTRAINT p14_policy_algorithm CHECK(date_algorithm_version='business-date-v2'),
 CONSTRAINT p14_policy_rev CHECK(policy_version>0),
 CONSTRAINT p14_policy_flags CHECK(archive_enabled IN (0,1) AND combined_enabled IN (0,1)
  AND (combined_enabled=0 OR archive_enabled=1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE branch_posting_guards (
 organization_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 branch_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 active_policy_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 live_revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 archive_revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,branch_id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_guard_branch_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id)
  REFERENCES branches(organization_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_guard_policy_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id,active_policy_id)
  REFERENCES business_posting_policies(organization_id,branch_id,id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE business_periods (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
 organization_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 branch_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 date_start DATE NOT NULL,
 date_end_exclusive DATE NOT NULL,
 live_state VARCHAR(12) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 archive_state VARCHAR(12) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 version BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 policy_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 changed_by INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 changed_at_utc DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE KEY p14_period_tenant(organization_id,id),
 UNIQUE KEY p14_period_branch(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 UNIQUE KEY p14_period_start(organization_id,branch_id,date_start),
 CONSTRAINT p14_period_branch_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id)
  REFERENCES branches(organization_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_period_policy_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id,policy_id)
  REFERENCES business_posting_policies(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_period_actor_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,changed_by)
  REFERENCES users(organization_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_period_states CHECK(live_state IN ('OPEN','CLOSED')
  AND archive_state IN ('OPEN','CLOSED')),
 CONSTRAINT p14_period_version CHECK(version>0),
 CONSTRAINT p14_period_month CHECK(
  CASE WHEN date_start<'1000-01-01' OR date_start>='9999-12-01' THEN FALSE
  ELSE DAYOFMONTH(date_start)=1
   AND date_end_exclusive=DATE_ADD(date_start,INTERVAL 1 MONTH) END)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

ALTER TABLE stock_documents
 ADD COLUMN business_date DATE NULL,
 ADD COLUMN business_timezone VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
 ADD COLUMN date_policy_version VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
 ADD COLUMN business_date_origin VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
 ADD COLUMN writer_epoch INT UNSIGNED NULL,
 ADD COLUMN posting_revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 ADD COLUMN policy_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 ADD COLUMN period_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 ADD COLUMN accepted_at_utc DATETIME(6) NULL,
 ADD UNIQUE KEY p14_document_branch(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 ADD UNIQUE KEY p14_document_identity(organization_id,branch_id,type,request_key,id),
 ADD UNIQUE KEY p14_document_revision(organization_id,branch_id,posting_revision),
 ADD CONSTRAINT p14_doc_policy_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id,policy_id)
  REFERENCES business_posting_policies(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 ADD CONSTRAINT p14_doc_period_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id,period_id)
  REFERENCES business_periods(organization_id,branch_id,id);

CREATE TABLE document_request_receipts (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
 organization_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 branch_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 document_type ENUM('RECEIPT','SALE') CHARACTER SET {{TYPE_CHARSET}} COLLATE {{TYPE_COLLATION}} NOT NULL,
 request_key VARCHAR(80) CHARACTER SET {{KEY_CHARSET}} COLLATE {{KEY_COLLATION}} NOT NULL,
 request_schema_version VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 envelope_hash BINARY(32) NOT NULL,
 resolved_hash BINARY(32) NOT NULL,
 business_date DATE NOT NULL,
 policy_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 period_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 accepted_at_utc DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
 document_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 response_version VARCHAR(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 response_json JSON NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE KEY p14_receipt_tenant(organization_id,id),
 UNIQUE KEY p14_receipt_request(organization_id,document_type,request_key),
 UNIQUE KEY p14_receipt_doc(organization_id,branch_id,document_id),
 UNIQUE KEY p14_receipt_finalize(organization_id,branch_id,document_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_receipt_doc_fk FOREIGN KEY
  (organization_id,branch_id,document_type,request_key,document_id)
  REFERENCES stock_documents(organization_id,branch_id,type,request_key,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_receipt_policy_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id,policy_id)
  REFERENCES business_posting_policies(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_receipt_period_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id,period_id)
  REFERENCES business_periods(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_receipt_date CHECK(business_date>='1000-01-01')
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE document_finalizations (
 organization_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 branch_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 document_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 kind VARCHAR(12) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 receipt_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 migration_manifest_sha256 BINARY(32) NULL,
 finalized_at_utc DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,document_id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_final_doc_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id,document_id)
  REFERENCES stock_documents(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_final_receipt_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id,document_id,receipt_id)
  REFERENCES document_request_receipts(organization_id,branch_id,document_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_final_kind CHECK(
  (kind='NATIVE' AND receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND migration_manifest_sha256 IS NULL)
  OR (kind='LEGACY' AND receipt_id IS NULL AND migration_manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE business_audit_events (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
 organization_id INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 branch_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
 actor_kind VARCHAR(12) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 actor_user_id INT UNSIGNED NULL,
 actor_service_ref VARCHAR(120) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NULL,
 action VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 target_kind VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 target_ref VARCHAR(100) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 correlation_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 occurred_at_utc DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
 policy_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 data_revision BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
 reason VARCHAR(1000) NULL,
 metadata JSON NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE KEY p14_audit_tenant(organization_id,id),
 KEY p14_audit_scope(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_audit_org_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_audit_branch_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id)
  REFERENCES branches(organization_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_audit_user_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,actor_user_id)
  REFERENCES users(organization_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_audit_policy_fk FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id,policy_id)
  REFERENCES business_posting_policies(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 CONSTRAINT p14_audit_actor CHECK(
  (actor_kind='USER' AND actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND actor_service_ref IS NULL)
  OR (actor_kind='SERVICE' AND actor_user_id IS NULL AND actor_service_ref IS NOT NULL)),
 CONSTRAINT p14_audit_policy_scope CHECK(policy_id IS NULL OR branch_id IS NOT NULL)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;
-- No data/bootstrap inserts in expand. No archive/AI schema created.

ALTER TABLE stock_documents
 MODIFY COLUMN business_date DATE NOT NULL,
 MODIFY COLUMN business_timezone VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 MODIFY COLUMN date_policy_version VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 MODIFY COLUMN business_date_origin VARCHAR(40) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
 MODIFY COLUMN writer_epoch INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 ADD CONSTRAINT p14_doc_date CHECK(business_date>='1000-01-01'),
 ADD CONSTRAINT p14_doc_zone CHECK(business_timezone='Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'),
 ADD CONSTRAINT p14_doc_lineage CHECK(
  (business_date_origin='DERIVED_FROM_RECORDED_AT' AND writer_epoch=0
   AND date_policy_version='recorded-time-iana-v1'
   AND posting_revision IS NULL AND policy_id IS NULL
   AND period_id IS NULL AND accepted_at_utc IS NULL)
  OR
  (business_date_origin='SERVER_TODAY' AND writer_epoch>0
   AND date_policy_version='business-date-v2'
   AND posting_revision IS NOT NULL AND posting_revision>0
   AND policy_id IS NOT NULL AND period_id IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at_utc IS NOT NULL));

ALTER TABLE inventory_movements
 ADD UNIQUE KEY p14_movement_document_product(organization_id,document_id,product_id),
 ADD CONSTRAINT p14_movement_doc_branch_fk
  FOREIGN KEY(organization_id,branch_id,document_id)
  REFERENCES stock_documents(organization_id,branch_id,id),
 ADD CONSTRAINT p14_movement_nonzero CHECK(quantity_delta<>0);

-- One branch-first candidate only, subject to native EXPLAIN/write-cost review.
-- Keep document_period(created_at); do not change legacy list ORDER BY id DESC.
CREATE INDEX p14_document_business_date
 ON stock_documents(organization_id,branch_id,business_date,id);

-- Parameters: UTC time, expected control version. Must affect exactly one row.
-- Remains MAINTENANCE; reader not switched until cutover.
UPDATE business_schema_control
SET schema_version=2,version=version+1,changed_at_utc=?
WHERE singleton_id=1 AND mode='MAINTENANCE' AND version=?;
-- No defaults for native business_date/epoch; legacy NULL lineage is intentional.
-- Do not MODIFY original created_at / request_key / payload_hash / money fields.

CREATE TRIGGER p14_policy_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON business_posting_policies
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
 SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='P14 append-only data';
END;

-- These guards do not supply a deferred commit hook.
-- Trusted runtime must insert receipt/audit/finalization before COMMIT.
-- Stored-procedure hardening against arbitrary DML requires a separate approval.

SELECT DATABASE() AS schema_name, @@server_uuid AS server_uuid,
       @@port AS server_port, VERSION() AS mysql_version,
       CURRENT_USER() AS authenticated_account,
       @@session.time_zone AS session_timezone, @@session.sql_mode AS sql_mode,
       @@session.transaction_isolation AS transaction_isolation;

SELECT table_name, engine, table_collation
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
ORDER BY table_name;

SELECT table_name, ordinal_position, column_name, column_type, is_nullable,
       column_default, character_set_name, collation_name, extra
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position;

SELECT table_name, index_name, non_unique, seq_in_index, column_name, sub_part
FROM information_schema.statistics
WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()
ORDER BY table_name, index_name, seq_in_index;

SELECT tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, tc.constraint_type,
       kcu.column_name, kcu.ordinal_position,
       kcu.referenced_table_name, kcu.referenced_column_name
FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
LEFT JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
 ON kcu.constraint_schema=tc.constraint_schema
 AND kcu.table_name=tc.table_name AND kcu.constraint_name=tc.constraint_name
WHERE tc.constraint_schema=DATABASE()
ORDER BY tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, kcu.ordinal_position;

SELECT tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, tc.enforced, cc.check_clause
FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN information_schema.check_constraints cc
 ON cc.constraint_schema=tc.constraint_schema AND cc.constraint_name=tc.constraint_name
WHERE tc.constraint_schema=DATABASE() AND tc.constraint_type='CHECK';

SELECT trigger_name, event_manipulation, event_object_table, action_timing,
       action_statement, sql_mode, character_set_client, collation_connection
FROM information_schema.triggers
WHERE trigger_schema=DATABASE()
ORDER BY event_object_table, action_timing, trigger_name;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_rows FROM stock_documents WHERE created_at IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_rows
FROM inventory_movements m
LEFT JOIN stock_documents d
 ON d.organization_id=m.organization_id AND d.id=m.document_id
WHERE d.id IS NULL OR d.branch_id<>m.branch_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_rows
FROM stock_documents d
LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT organization_id,document_id,COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(quantity*unit_price) AS total
 FROM stock_document_items GROUP BY organization_id,document_id
) x ON x.organization_id=d.organization_id AND x.document_id=d.id
WHERE COALESCE(x.n,0)=0 OR NOT(d.total <=> x.total);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_rows
FROM stock_document_items x
JOIN stock_documents d ON d.organization_id=x.organization_id AND d.id=x.document_id
LEFT JOIN inventory_movements m
 ON m.organization_id=x.organization_id AND m.document_id=x.document_id
 AND m.product_id=x.product_id
WHERE m.id IS NULL OR m.quantity_delta<>
 CASE WHEN d.type='SALE' THEN -x.quantity ELSE x.quantity END;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_rows
FROM inventory_movements m
LEFT JOIN stock_document_items x
 ON x.organization_id=m.organization_id AND x.document_id=m.document_id
 AND x.product_id=m.product_id
WHERE x.id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_rows
FROM (
 SELECT organization_id,branch_id,product_id,SUM(quantity_delta) AS quantity
 FROM inventory_movements GROUP BY organization_id,branch_id,product_id
) m
LEFT JOIN inventory_balances b ON b.organization_id=m.organization_id
 AND b.branch_id=m.branch_id AND b.product_id=m.product_id
WHERE b.product_id IS NULL OR b.quantity<>m.quantity;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_rows
FROM inventory_balances b
LEFT JOIN inventory_movements m ON m.organization_id=b.organization_id
 AND m.branch_id=b.branch_id AND m.product_id=b.product_id
WHERE m.id IS NULL AND b.quantity<>0;
-- Also collect SHOW CREATE TABLE, SHOW GRANTS/active roles, schema_migrations
-- and server/TLS identity using the future runner's redacted metadata adapter.
-- Invariant violations are NO-GO; no repair DML is included.

-- Parameters: UTC time. Exactly one seed, schema1 EXPAND writer epoch1.
INSERT INTO business_schema_control
 (singleton_id,mode,required_writer_epoch,schema_version,reader_basis,version,changed_at_utc)
VALUES(1,'EXPAND',1,1,'RECORDED_TIME',1,?);

-- Parameters: last_pk,high_watermark,chunk_limit (positive bounded integer).
SELECT id,organization_id,branch_id,created_at,payload_hash,total,
 business_date,business_timezone,date_policy_version,business_date_origin,
 writer_epoch,posting_revision,policy_id,period_id,accepted_at_utc
FROM stock_documents WHERE id>? AND id<=? ORDER BY id LIMIT ?;

-- Parameters: org,doc_id. Chunk transaction locks each target before update.
SELECT id,created_at,payload_hash,total,business_date,business_timezone,
 date_policy_version,business_date_origin,writer_epoch,posting_revision,
 policy_id,period_id,accepted_at_utc
FROM stock_documents WHERE organization_id=? AND id=? FOR UPDATE;

-- Parameters: DATE computed by pinned Temporal IANA from original UTC,
-- org,doc_id,expected original created_at.
-- UTC session mandatory; no SET created_at / total / payload_hash.
UPDATE stock_documents
SET business_date=?,business_timezone='Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
 date_policy_version='recorded-time-iana-v1',
 business_date_origin='DERIVED_FROM_RECORDED_AT',writer_epoch=0
WHERE organization_id=? AND id=? AND created_at=?
 AND business_date IS NULL AND business_timezone IS NULL
 AND date_policy_version IS NULL AND business_date_origin IS NULL
 AND writer_epoch IS NULL AND posting_revision IS NULL
 AND policy_id IS NULL AND period_id IS NULL AND accepted_at_utc IS NULL;

-- Parameters: org,branch,version,effective_from_utc,real authorized actor,created_at_utc.
-- No hidden user and no policy fabricated for legacy documents.
INSERT INTO business_posting_policies
 (organization_id,branch_id,policy_version,business_timezone,date_algorithm_version,
  live_date_mode,archive_enabled,combined_enabled,effective_from_utc,created_by,created_at_utc)
VALUES(?,?,?,'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh','business-date-v2','TODAY_ONLY',FALSE,FALSE,?,?,?);

-- Parameters: org,branch,approved policy_id (same org/branch).
INSERT INTO branch_posting_guards
 (organization_id,branch_id,active_policy_id,live_revision,archive_revision)
VALUES(?,?,?,0,0);

-- Parameters: org,branch,date_start,date_end_exclusive,
-- live_state,archive_state,policy_id,real actor,changed_at_utc.
-- States from approval manifest; never default missing period to OPEN.
INSERT INTO business_periods
 (organization_id,branch_id,date_start,date_end_exclusive,live_state,archive_state,
  version,policy_id,changed_by,changed_at_utc)
VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,1,?,?,?);

-- Parameters: org,branch,doc_id,manifest SHA256 bytes,finalized UTC.
-- Only after full original-item/movement/economic reconciliation.
INSERT INTO document_finalizations
 (organization_id,branch_id,document_id,kind,receipt_id,
  migration_manifest_sha256,finalized_at_utc)
VALUES(?,?,?,'LEGACY',NULL,?,?);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_rows FROM stock_documents d
LEFT JOIN document_finalizations f
 ON f.organization_id=d.organization_id AND f.document_id=d.id
WHERE f.document_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_rows FROM branches b
LEFT JOIN branch_posting_guards g
 ON g.organization_id=b.organization_id AND g.branch_id=b.id
WHERE b.status='ACTIVE' AND (g.branch_id IS NULL OR g.active_policy_id IS NULL);

-- Bootstrap audit uses business_audit_events prepared insert through future
-- operator adapter, SERVICE actor + manifest reference, no invented actor ID.
-- Atomic chunk checkpoint/receipt SQL is runner implementation work in A1,
-- not a missing instruction to execute templates manually.

-- Parameters: UTC time,expected control version; exactly one affected row.
-- Execute BEFORE final tail/30/40/41, COMMIT this change, keep ingress closed.
UPDATE business_schema_control
SET mode='MAINTENANCE',version=version+1,changed_at_utc=?
WHERE singleton_id=1 AND mode IN ('EXPAND','ENFORCED') AND version=?;

-- Parameters: approved new epoch,UTC time,expected version.
-- Separate later transaction, only AFTER 30/40/41 verified, old credentials fenced,
-- all native tests/parity/bootstrap evidence, app readiness and release approval.
UPDATE business_schema_control
SET mode='ENFORCED',required_writer_epoch=?,reader_basis='BUSINESS_DATE',
 version=version+1,changed_at_utc=?
WHERE singleton_id=1 AND mode='MAINTENANCE' AND schema_version=2 AND version=?;

-- Parameters: UTC time,expected version.
-- Alternative recovery branch ONLY in maintenance under separate approval.
-- Keep writer epoch and schema version; never reopen old binary.
UPDATE business_schema_control
SET reader_basis='RECORDED_TIME',version=version+1,changed_at_utc=?
WHERE singleton_id=1 AND mode='MAINTENANCE' AND version=?;
-- Do not execute CO_ACTIVATE and recovery as a blind sequential script.
-- A later operator may reopen ENFORCED with RECORDED_TIME only in an approved
-- release whose reader fallback and new-epoch-compatible writer have been tested.
